title: Supabase keys in a client bundle: service_role is the leak, anon and publishable are public by design

mustFind.why: A Supabase service_role key bypasses RLS: anyone reading the bundle owns the database.

mustNotFlag.why: The anon key is public by design. At most a lead pointing to RLS, never high or critical on its own.
